name: yanshu-workbench
description: Extensible research workflows coordinated across local files, pluggable executors, and deterministic validation.

interface.shortDescription: Installable research workflows for writing, figures, and publication.
interface.longDescription: YanShu is an extensible research-workflow plugin with six independent, directly invokable sub-skills: $idea-discovery, $paper-drafting, $writing-diagnosis, $paper-reconstruction, $scientific-figure, and $experimental-plotting. Every workflow opens one website-synchronized local configuration page before execution. Codex coordinates approved local evidence, visible ChatGPT sessions where appropriate, versioned outputs, compilation, validation, fallbacks, and recovery. Optional external writing and experimental-plotting skills use one explicit consent receipt and exact sub-skill allowlists; YanShu never installs an entire third-party skill repository.
defaultPrompt: Use $paper-reconstruction to configure and reconstruct this manuscript directory.
Use $idea-discovery to find evidence-backed research ideas in this workspace.
Use $paper-drafting to draft a paper from completed experiments.
Use $writing-diagnosis to diagnose recurring academic writing problems in this manuscript.
Use $scientific-figure to create one publication-ready research figure.
Use $experimental-plotting to create a reproducible publication plot from experimental data.
Use $paper-reconstruction to inspect whether this directory has the required TeX, PDF, BibTeX, and figure inputs.
Use $paper-reconstruction to resume the interrupted reconstruction run in this paper directory.
